messages:
Tara: Quick UX review: compact timeline scrubber feels cramped on smaller windows. Thumb is tiny and focus ring gets lost. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/figma/scrubber-v3.png
Devon: Noted. Can we increase thumb hit target to 18px and make focus ring 4px with offset? Keeps visual size but better keyboard discoverability.
Lena: Also, the microcopy on hover reads 'v3 -> rollback'. Feels scary. Suggest 'View v3 details' and keep rollback only in the details modal.
a11y-bot: Contrast check: scrubber thumb border meets contrast, but focus outline insufficient for low-vision users. Recommend 3:1 AA for focus.
Tara: Plan: 1) larger hit area for thumb 2) stronger focus ring 3) rename tooltip to 'View v{n} details' and move destructive action to modal. Can design push updated figma by EOD?
Devon: Yep. I'll add CSS proposal in PR and ensure arrow-key scrub behavior uses aria-activedescendant.
Lena: I'll update copy and add aria-labels: 'Version {n}, {percent} traffic, {state}'.
Tara: Great. Follow-up: test keyboard-only flow and mobile tap targets in QA checklist. :+1:
